description: Get geolocation and network info for any IP address (e.g., "8.8.8.8"). Returns city, region, country, coordinates, org, postal code, timezone.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up (e.g., "8.8.8.8")

name: lookup_ip

city.description: City name associated with the IP address

country.description: Country code associated with the IP address

ip.description: The IP address that was looked up

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the IP geolocation

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the IP geolocation

postal.description: Postal code associated with the IP address

region.description: Region or state associated with the IP address

timezone.description: Timezone associated with the IP address

title: Lookup Ip
